import json,sys
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait,Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
from selenium.common.exceptions import StaleElementReferenceException
s=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
options=webdriver.ChromeOptions();options.set_capability('goog:loggingPrefs',{'browser':'ALL'});options.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
for option in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--window-size=1440,1100']:options.add_argument(option)
d=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=options)
w=WebDriverWait(d,8,ignored_exceptions=(StaleElementReferenceException,))
def text():return d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text
def button(label):return d.find_element(By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()='+json.dumps(label)+']')
def field(label):return d.find_element(By.XPATH,'//label[span[normalize-space()='+json.dumps(label)+']]//*[self::input or self::textarea or self::select]')
def change(label,value):
    el=field(label);el.clear();el.send_keys(value)
def click(label):w.until(lambda _:button(label).is_enabled());button(label).click()
def route(path,title):
    d.get(s['url']+'/#'+path)
    w.until(lambda _ : d.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME,'h1') and title in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'h1').text)
def request(method,path,body=None):
    return d.execute_async_script("""const done=arguments[arguments.length-1];fetch('/api/v1'+arguments[1],{method:arguments[0],headers:{'X-Crew-Request':'1','content-type':'application/json'},body:arguments[2]===null?undefined:JSON.stringify(arguments[2])}).then(async r=>done({status:r.status,data:await r.json()})).catch(e=>done({error:String(e)}));""",method,path,body)
def role():return request('GET','/orgs/'+s['orgId']+'/members/'+s['userId']+'/access')['data']['membership']['role']
try:
    d.get(s['url'])
    if s['mode']=='lifetime':
        w.until(lambda _:d.execute_script('return !!window.double'))
        d.execute_script('window.double()');w.until(lambda _:'busy' in text())
        assert d.execute_script('return proof.calls.length')==1
        d.execute_script("window.scope('opaque-link-b')")
        w.until(lambda _:'opaque-link-b idle' in text())
        assert d.execute_script('return window.cancelled()')==[True]
        d.execute_script("proof.resolve('old accepted result')")
        assert d.execute_script('return proof.effects.length+proof.completions.length')==0
        d.execute_script('window.run()');w.until(lambda _:'busy' in text())
        d.execute_script("proof.reject(new Error('current error'))")
        w.until(lambda _:'current error' in text())
        d.execute_script('window.run()');w.until(lambda _:'busy' in text())
        d.execute_script("proof.resolve('current value')")
        w.until(lambda _:'Saved opaque-link-b' in text())
        assert d.execute_script('return proof.effects')==[['opaque-link-b','current value']]
        d.execute_script("window.run();window.unmount();")
        w.until(lambda _:not d.find_elements(By.ID,'action-state'))
        assert d.execute_script('return window.cancelled().at(-1)')
        d.execute_script("proof.resolve('after unmount')")
        assert d.execute_script('return proof.effects.length')==1
        w.until(lambda _:len(d.execute_script('return proof.resolvers'))>=2)
        d.execute_script("proof.resolvers.find(x=>x.path==='/opaque-link-b?limit=1').resolve({items:[{id:'b-first'}],nextCursor:'b-next'})")
        w.until(lambda _:'b-first' in text());d.execute_script('window.next()')
        w.until(lambda _:any('cursor=b-next' in x for x in d.execute_script('return proof.reads')))
        d.execute_script("window.scope('new-query-c')")
        w.until(lambda _:'new-query-c Page 1 loading' in text())
        reads=d.execute_script('return proof.reads');assert '/new-query-c?limit=1' in reads
        assert not any('new-query-c' in value and 'cursor=' in value for value in reads)
        d.execute_script("proof.resolvers.find(x=>x.path.includes('cursor=b-next')).resolve({items:[{id:'old-scope-secret'}],nextCursor:null})")
        assert 'old-scope-secret' not in text()
        d.execute_script("proof.resolvers.find(x=>x.path==='/new-query-c?limit=1').resolve({items:[{id:'c-first'}],nextCursor:null})")
        w.until(lambda _:'c-first' in text())
    else:
        name,value=s['cookie'].split('=',1);d.add_cookie({'name':name,'value':value,'path':'/'});d.refresh();w.until(lambda _:'Browser owner' in text())
        base='/orgs/'+s['orgId']
        if s['mode']=='access':
            route(base+'/members/'+s['userId']+'/access','Browser guest · Member access')
            w.until(lambda _:'221 matching projects' in text())
            click('Next page');w.until(lambda _:'Page 2' in text() and 'PAGE019' in text())
            change('Search projects','PAGE219');click('Search projects')
            w.until(lambda _:'Browser project 219 (archived)' in text() and 'Page 1' in text())
            click('Add direct grant');w.until(EC.alert_is_present());assert 'PAGE219' in d.switch_to.alert.text;d.switch_to.alert.accept()
            w.until(lambda _:'Recorded, effective' in text())
            click('Remove direct grant');w.until(EC.alert_is_present());d.switch_to.alert.accept();w.until(lambda _:'Direct grant removed.' in text())
            change('Search projects','BROWSE');click('Search projects');w.until(lambda _:'Original project' in text() and 'PAGE219' not in text())
            click('Add direct grant');w.until(EC.alert_is_present());d.switch_to.alert.accept();w.until(lambda _:'Recorded, effective' in text())
            Select(field('Proposed role')).select_by_visible_text('member');assert role()=='guest'
            click('Review role change');w.until(lambda _:'Role change impact' in d.page_source)
            assert 'Projects accessible' in text() and 'Capabilities' in text() and 'Direct grants remain 1' in text()
            click('Cancel role change');assert role()=='guest'
            click('Review role change');click('Confirm role change');w.until(lambda _:'Recorded, dormant' in text())
            Select(field('Proposed role')).select_by_visible_text('guest');click('Review role change')
            assert '220 projects lose role-derived access' in text()
            click('Confirm role change');w.until(lambda _:'Recorded, effective' in text())
            click('Remove direct grant');w.until(EC.alert_is_present());assert 'Project access will be lost' in d.switch_to.alert.text;d.switch_to.alert.accept()
            w.until(lambda _:'No access' in text())
        elif s['mode']=='drafts':
            route(base+'/members','Browser administration · Members')
            w.until(lambda _:field('Organization name').get_attribute('value')=='Browser administration')
            change('Organization name','My chosen organization')
            assert request('PATCH',base,{'name':'Peer organization'})['status']==200
            click('Inspect latest version');w.until(lambda _:'newer saved version' in text())
            assert field('Organization name').get_attribute('value')=='My chosen organization'
            d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'input[type=radio][value=mine]').click();click('Apply selected field choices');click('Save name')
            w.until(lambda _:'Organization renamed.' in text())
            route('/teams/'+s['teamId'],'Browser team')
            w.until(lambda _:field('Name').get_attribute('value')=='Browser team')
            change('Name','My chosen team')
            assert request('PATCH','/teams/'+s['teamId'],{'name':'Browser team','description':'Peer description'})['status']==200
            click('Inspect latest version');w.until(lambda _:'newer saved version' in text())
            assert field('Name').get_attribute('value')=='My chosen team'
            click('Keep my changes on latest version');click('Save team');w.until(lambda _:'Team saved.' in text())
            assert request('GET','/teams/'+s['teamId'])['data']['team']['description']=='Peer description'
            change('Name','Retained after access loss')
            assert request('PATCH',base+'/members/'+s['userId'],{'role':'owner'})['status']==200
            owner=request('GET','/me')['data']['user']['id']
            assert request('DELETE',base+'/members/'+owner)['status']==200
            click('Inspect latest version');w.until(lambda _:'Retained local draft after access loss' in text())
            assert field('Retained name').get_attribute('value')=='Retained after access loss'
        else:
            route(base+'/audit','Organization security audit')
            w.until(lambda _:'View changes' in text())
            Select(field('Entity type')).select_by_visible_text('team')
            assert 'Unapplied filter changes' in text()
            click('Apply filters');w.until(lambda _:'Showing the applied filters' in text() and 'View changes' in text())
            click('View changes');w.until(lambda _:d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'section[aria-label="Audit event details"]'))
            details=d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'section[aria-label="Audit event details"]').text
            assert 'Before' in details and 'After' in details and 'Browser team' in details
            change('From, exact UTC','2026-10-16T00:00:00+08:00');click('Apply filters');w.until(lambda _:'Use exact UTC' in text())
            click('Clear filters');w.until(lambda _:'View changes' in text())
            actor=d.find_element(By.XPATH,'//fieldset[legend[normalize-space()="Actors"]]//select');w.until(lambda _:len(Select(actor).options)>1)
            Select(actor).select_by_index(1);click('Apply filters');w.until(lambda _:'Showing the applied filters' in text())
            assert 'Selected actors:' in text()
            route('/orgs/'+s['otherOrgId']+'/audit','Organization security audit')
            w.until(lambda _:'Showing the applied filters' in text())
            assert 'Selected actors:' not in text() and 'Browser team' not in text()
    print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'mode':s['mode']}))
except Exception:
    print(json.dumps({'diagnosticMode':s['mode'],'url':d.current_url,'body':text(),'logs':d.get_log('browser'),'selects':[x.get_attribute('outerHTML') for x in d.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME,'select')]}),file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:d.quit()
